note: Mining recall: of a company's real leading demand-driver signals, what fraction did the model's actual search queries or retrieved snippets touch? Scored on an already-collected 50-company sample, no new model calls. Only available where per-query search logs were retained (agentic mining over CC-News) -- structurally inapplicable to no-search conditions (blind, Oracle), and not yet computed for conditions whose logs only kept query counts, not text (fan-out, weekly, live-web).
